scenario: 今天检索赛道的主线是，相似度和排序分数都不等于用户真正要的东西。Yuanbao-Reranker 让负例之间也分出先后，Jev 的校准研究发现排得准的模型概率照样偏乐观，好在两个参数就能修回大半。另一篇论文说明向量检索会偏向模型已知的答案，TRIAD 则发现把需求拆到多轮说，多模态检索几乎都会变差。工程这一侧，Lightfoot 把 GraphRAG 的精确删除做成数据库操作，NIFT-SQL 用每家客户自己的问题训练找表模型。

papers.title: Yuanbao-Reranker: Document-Grounded Synthesis and Preference Distillation for Text Reranking
papers.authors: Hongyuan Xu, Dezhi Ye, Jiahao Cao, Jie Liu, Haijin Liang, Haibo Shi, Jin Ma
papers.abstract: High-precision text reranking is a critical component in modern search, recommendation, and agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems. We present Yuanbao-Reranker, a family of general-purpose dense rerankers spanning 0.6B, 4B, and 8B parameter scales built upon the Qwen3 backbone. To construct diverse and reliable ranking supervision at scale, we pair answer-first and query-type-guided document-grounded synthesis with a three-stage curation funnel that verifies positive support, eliminates semantic redundancy, and enforces balanced source-by-length quotas. For each curated pair, we screen real retrieval pools with a teacher score margin to filter out potential false negatives and sample Hard, Medium, and Moderate negative tiers, yielding 2.75M $1{:}3$ ranking groups. We train the models by jointly optimizing pointwise relevance cross-entropy and a bounded minimum-gap hinge objective over both positive--negative and negative--negative pairs. This formulation transfers fine-grained teacher preferences across candidate tiers without over-constraining well-separated predictions, supporting both cross-scale and same-scale distillation followed by layerwise adaptive model merging. Across five comprehensive benchmarks spanning Chinese (CMTEB-R), multilingual (MMTEB-R), English (BEIR), long-document (MLDR), and code (MTEB-Code) retrieval, Yuanbao-Reranker consistently leads every parameter tier: the 0.6B variant reaches 70.96 Avg. to surpass 1B--4B active-parameter baselines, the 4B variant reaches 73.63 Avg. to outperform the 8B teacher (72.68), and the 8B variant achieves a state-of-the-art 74.21 Avg., with substantial gains generalizing across distinct first-stage retrievers.
papers.assessment_note: 五类检索基准、三种规模、消融及独立召回器验证；腾讯搜索作者单位已核验
papers.summary: 用相关和不相关两个标签做 pointwise 微调的 reranker 有个缺口：同一个 query 的负例全都标成不相关，模型学不出哪个负例更接近正例。腾讯元宝搜索给每个正例配三个难度不同的负例，再加一项蒸馏损失：老师模型给出的两篇文档分差被当作下限，学生拉开到这个距离就不再受罚。在没参与训练的分组上，三档负例完全排对的比例从 36.4% 涨到 69.7%，而正负例的区分本来就接近满分。把下限换成平方误差去贴分差，平均分比不加这一项还低，因为已经拉开的分差会被往回压。==负例内部的先后才是二分类标签漏掉的信息==，最终 4B 学生的五项平均分超过了当老师的 8B 模型，训练 reranker 时值得先看负例的分数是不是都挤在一起。

deep_reading.title: Yuanbao-Reranker: Document-Grounded Synthesis and Preference Distillation for Text Reranking

papers.title: Beyond Ranking: Are Decision Models Calibrated Relevance Scorers?
papers.authors: Shengyao Zhuang, Xueguang Ma, Matthias Petri, Jimmy Lin
papers.abstract: Decision models such as Jev are a new kind of relevance scorer. Their typed score primitive takes a question, an ordered set of textual relevance levels and a state, and returns a probability for each level directly, rather than token likelihoods or generated labels. Jev's vendor promises that these probabilities are calibrated. This motivates revisiting 'Beyond Yes and No', which improved zero-shot pointwise LLM reranking using likelihood-derived scores over fine-grained relevance labels but left calibration against human assessors as future work. In this paper, we first reproduce its open-model FLAN-UL2 setting on eight BEIR collections, confirming its ranking trends, and then run Jev and two open-weight decision models with the same protocol. Jev and the 27B pplx-decider rerank ahead of FLAN-UL2 and three cross-encoders on average. We then compare Jev's native probabilities with the human assessors' labels and find them overconfident: of the DL21 pairs it scores above 0.9, only 66% are relevant. Since this is mostly an error of scale, a two-parameter calibration fitted on 2,257 DL19 pairs removes much of it and transfers to DL21. After calibration, Jev has a lower DL21 Brier score than FLAN-UL2 and the three cross-encoders, mainly because it separates relevant from non-relevant pairs better. Finally, with calibrated probabilities, choosing each query's cut-off by expected F1 needs no parameter of its own, beats a fixed top-10 cut and matches a cut-off threshold tuned on DL19.
papers.assessment_note: 八个BEIR集合与跨年校准；可直接复现评分和截断方案
papers.summary: Jev 这类决策模型不生成文字，直接给每个相关性等级输出一个概率，厂商还承诺这些概率是校准过的，可此前的独立检查都没拿它和人工分级标注对过。作者用 TREC 人工标注去对，发现它打到 0.9 以上的文档里只有 66% 真的相关，一起测的模型也都偏乐观。错的主要是刻度，用一年的标注拟合两个参数的 Platt 校准，换到新一年、新语料上照样能修回大半。校准后按期望 F1 给每个 query 决定留几篇，不用调阈值，效果就和专门调过的阈值持平，明显好过固定取前十篇。换到其他领域的语料，这份校准的效果就不稳定了，有的语料变好，有的变差。==排得准不代表概率准==，做 RAG 想按概率截断上下文，手里至少要有一份自己的人工标注来校准。

deep_reading.title: Beyond Ranking: Are Decision Models Calibrated Relevance Scorers?

papers.title: Lightfoot: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Exact, Model-Free Document Deletion
papers.abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) improves multi-hop question answering, but deployed systems face two costs that research comparisons rarely measure: building the graph, and removing documents from it. We present Lightfoot, a GraphRAG system in which every entity, link, fact and synonym edge is a deterministic function of per-passage extractions carrying chunk-level provenance. Indexing makes one language-model call per passage, retrieval makes none, and deleting a document is a database operation with no model calls. On the full 11,402-passage MuSiQue corpus we verify that, after deleting 10% of the documents, the graph is identical to a fresh index of the surviving documents. We compare Lightfoot with HippoRAG 2, LightRAG and fast-graphrag under identical extraction, answer and embedding models on MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA and HotpotQA. Lightfoot builds the cheapest index on all three datasets, 26-31% below HippoRAG 2 and 3-6x below LightRAG and fast-graphrag. Against HippoRAG 2 it is significantly better on MuSiQue retrieval (+2.8 points recall@5 and +4.3 recall@10 on a held-out split) and on HotpotQA answers (+7.7 points exact match), and significantly worse on 2WikiMultiHopQA (-3.9 recall@2, -8.4 F1). Deleting the same documents took LightRAG 2,187 model calls and 3.7 hours; fast-graphrag has no deletion path. Code and per-question results: https://github.com/udayallu-ml/Lightfoot-GraphRAG
papers.assessment_note: 三个QA数据集、删除等价验证、成本和负向结果均报告
papers.summary: GraphRAG 上线后有两笔账论文很少算：建图花多少钱，删文档有多麻烦。合同到期或用户要求删除时，要把一篇文档和由它派生的内容都清掉，可混了多篇文档内容的实体摘要很难拆干净。Lightfoot 规定图里每条记录都只由单段的抽取结果算出来，每段只调一次模型，检索不调模型，删文档就是数据库操作，建图成本在三个数据集上也都最低。在 MuSiQue 全量语料上删掉 10% 的文档后，图和只用剩余文档重建的结果完全相同，LightRAG 删同样的文档要调 2187 次模型、跑 3.7 小时。代价是准确率和 HippoRAG 2 互有胜负，在 2WikiMultiHopQA 上明显落后。==能精确删除，靠的是没有任何记录来自读过多段内容的模型调用==，有合规删除需求的团队可以照这条约束设计索引。

deep_reading.title: Lightfoot: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Exact, Model-Free Document Deletion

papers.title: PatternBloom: Empowering Agentic RAG with Externalized RL-Distilled Graph Patterns
papers.abstract: Reinforcement-learning-trained agents for retrieval-augmented generation retrieve content (passages, knowledge-graph fragments, or hyperedges) and supervise training with outcome rewards on the final answer. Across these paradigms the reasoning route through retrieved content never leaves the language model's hidden state, conflating declarative knowledge with the procedural knowledge that recurs across queries of the same logical type; content-only methods consequently plateau as reasoning depth grows. We introduce PatternBloom, an agentic RAG framework that shifts the unit of retrieval from content (what to read) to logic (how to reason). A first RL stage scores the agent's constructed evidence graph by a frozen oracle's information gain through the Information-Density Reward (IDR), a size-normalized mutual-information surrogate. High-reward trajectories are distilled into a Graph Pattern Memory (GPM) of type-abstracted reasoning skeletons, and a second RL stage uses the Pattern-Augmented Reward (PAR) to couple policy to memory, turning procedural reasoning into a learnable, externalized structural prior. A 7B PatternBloom outperforms $27$ baselines by $+15.0$ Avg-OOD EM, with the gain compounding with reasoning depth precisely because procedural knowledge, once distilled, is reused rather than re-derived at every query. We release our code at https://github.com/EllenYiGe/PatternBloom.
papers.assessment_note: 两阶段RL与图模式复用；27个基线及OOD实验
papers.summary: 用强化学习训练的 RAG agent 能学会找更好的内容，可同一类问题该按什么步骤推理，每次都要从头推一遍，只检索内容的方法在问题变深时就上不去分。问两部不同电影的导演生在哪国，步骤其实一样：电影、导演、国家。PatternBloom 把高分的推理过程抽象成只保留实体类型的模板（论文叫 Graph Pattern Memory），一共 27 条，放在模型外面，回答时先查模板再沿着模板找证据。在训练时没见过的五个数据集上，7B 版的平均 EM 是 49.0，同为 7B 的训练型方法里最高的 Search-R1 是 38.1。==多跳问答里反复出现的推理路径，本身也可以当检索对象==。做 agent 搜索的团队可以把常见问题的查询步骤沉淀成人能读、能改的模板，不过这里的实验都在维基百科语料上。

papers.title: Search-by-Answer Bias in Retrieval Models
papers.authors: Adiel Avigad, Shauli Ravfogel, Yoav Goldberg
papers.abstract: Dense retrievers are meant to select passages that match a query's semantic specification. We show they suffer from search-by-answer bias: they favor passages that mention answer objects the model knows (scores as likely), over passages that support valid alternative answers. We test this with controlled factual contrasts from LAMA/TREx. For each retriever, we measure how strongly the model scores the canonical object over an alternative object using a token-prediction head, and ask whether this score predicts passage rankings. Across eight retrievers, including DPR, Spider variants, Contriever, E5, and Qwen3-Embedding, larger token-prediction scores consistently predict higher retrieval scores for passages containing the corresponding object. This holds when passages differ only in the answer object, and even when the passage that mentions the high-scoring object expresses a wrong relation. Dense retrieval thus exhibits search-by-answer bias during passage selection, shaping which evidence is retrieved.
papers.assessment_note: 八种召回器受控事实对照；任务外推广尚待验证
papers.summary: 向量检索本该按 query 问的关系找段落，可检索模型自带世界知识，这篇发现它会偏向模型本来就知道的答案，冷门或更新的答案可能因此吃亏。作者造了成对的句子，一种只换答案实体，另一种让关系对的句子配替代答案、关系错的句子配熟悉答案。八个检索模型上，模型给某个答案的概率越高，含这个答案的段落得分就越高。在模型本就偏向标准答案的样本里，Qwen3-Embedding-8B 只换答案时有 94.6% 选熟悉的那句，无偏时应是 50%，关系错的句子也有 65.0% 排在前面。==答案不止一个或者会过时的查询，召回容易被模型记住的答案带偏==。实验句子都是模板生成的，不过在答案本来就有多个的 QAMPARI 上，各检索模型同样偏向已知答案。

papers.title: CoRA-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation by Context Selectors Under Token Budgets
papers.authors: Huzaifa Pardawala, Siddhant Sukhani, Sudheer Chava, Agam Shah
papers.abstract: Context selection can reduce input length during long-input inference but can remove evidence required to answer a query. We introduce CoRA-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating evidence preservation under shared token budgets. We compare head and tail truncation, BM25, dense retrieval, dense retrieval with reranking, LLMLingua-2, and Provence across BABILong, LOONG Financial Spotlight, a custom NoLiMa diagnostic, and LongMemEval. Evidence-preservation results reveal task-dependent tradeoffs: BM25 achieves 0.921 supporting-fact recall on BABILong at 128K, dense retrieval and dense reranking each achieve 0.908 needle recall on NoLiMa at 64K, and dense retrieval achieves 0.993 answer-bearing-turn recall on LongMemEval at 64K. Evidence, token retention, and complementary reader evaluations use the same selected contexts. Reader evaluations use dataset-native answer metrics and three runs on the same questions, with paired bootstrap confidence intervals. At a 32K budget, BM25 achieves 46.20% BABILong answer accuracy and dense retrieval achieves 71.13% LongMemEval accuracy. The results show that method rankings vary across evidence types and between evidence recall and downstream accuracy.
papers.assessment_note: 多种上下文选择器、相同token预算、重复实验及置信区间
papers.summary: 长上下文推理前先筛一遍内容能省 token，也可能把答案证据筛掉，而截断、检索、压缩这几类方法一直缺一个统一的比法。CoRA-Bench 在相同 token 预算下比了截断、BM25、向量检索、重排和两种压缩方法，证据召回和答题准确率都在同一份筛选结果上算，结果没有哪种方法通吃。在证据和问题字面重合很少的 NoLiMa 上，向量检索的证据召回是 0.908，BM25 只有 0.467，到了字面线索明显的 BABILong，BM25 反过来领先。保住证据也不等于答对，会改写文本的 Provence 在 LongMemEval 上按逐字标准几乎没留下完整证据，答题准确率却有 66.60%。==选上下文筛选方法时，证据召回和答题准确率要分开看==，做长文档问答或记忆检索的人可以按自家证据靠字面匹配还是语义联想来挑方法。

papers.title: TRIAD: Multimodal Retrieval across Abstraction, Constraints, and State
papers.authors: Xiangyang Wu, Chen Ju, Xu Chen, Likang Peng, Jinsong Lan, Haihong Tang, Yang Hu
papers.abstract: Multimodal retrieval increasingly supports agentic systems, where user requests can involve cross-level relations, combine multiple constraints, and evolve across dialogue turns. In these settings, a highly similar result may still violate the user's requirements, while retrieved content may directly inform downstream actions without human screening. We introduce TRIAD, a multimodal retrieval benchmark for evaluating how well retrieval systems satisfy these complex, evolving requests. TRIAD comprises three tracks: abstraction, testing bidirectional retrieval between visual instances and concepts at different hierarchical levels; constraints, testing the joint satisfaction of positive and negative conditions; and state, testing the integration of requirements across dialogue turns and the updating of earlier conditions when users revise their requests. The benchmark contains six subsets, each with 1,000 queries and a fixed pool of 1,000 candidates per query, evaluated using a common multi-positive mean average precision (mAP) protocol. Simpler reference tasks and hard negatives grouped by the requirements they violate help characterize specific retrieval difficulties. We evaluate 20 configurations of 17 systems and find that no system leads across all six subsets. Performance declines with hierarchical distance, and negative-only queries generally underperform positive-only queries with the same number of constraints. Across paired tasks expressing the same final intent, multi-turn retrieval yields lower mAP in 39 of 40 configuration-domain comparisons. The benefits of explicit reasoning also vary across models and tasks. These findings highlight the gap between retrieving similar content and satisfying a complete request.
papers.assessment_note: 六子集与17个系统；多轮/否定约束贴近查询理解
papers.summary: agent 场景下的多模态检索，排在前面的结果可能很相似，却不满足用户的要求，而这些结果常常直接进入下一步推理或工具调用，没有人帮忙把关。TRIAD 用上下位概念、正反约束、多轮对话三类任务测了二十种模型配置，没有哪个系统在六个子集上全部领先。多轮任务的结果最明显：把同一个最终需求拆成几轮说，40 组比较里有 39 组 mAP 下降，掉分集中在用户中途改条件的会话，比如先要橙色后改蓝色。只留最后一轮也救不回来，整体上比保留完整历史更差。加上显式推理也不是万能的，效果随模型和任务变化。==多轮检索既要留住还有效的条件，又要清掉被改掉的旧值==，做对话式搜索的团队应该单独测用户改口的会话。

papers.title: NIFT-SQL: Customer-Supervised Table Scoring for Enterprise Text-to-SQL Retrieval
papers.abstract: Enterprise text-to-SQL starts with finding the tables a question needs, which is hard when a schema spans several databases and hundreds of cryptic tables. We ask whether models trained separately on each customer's example questions, reading only table names, column names, and declared keys, improve table retrieval. NIFT-SQL (Necessity-Informed Fusion for Text-to-SQL) fuses hybrid search over a retriever fine-tuned on the customer's questions with a fine-tuned 560M cross-encoder that scores every table for whether the query needs it, through a logistic regression fitted on held-out questions. On BEAVER, LiveSQLBench, and LiveSQLBench-Large (244 to 971 tables; four splits, three trainings), NIFT-SQL places every reference table in the top 15 for 69.2%, 89.5%, and 85.6% of test questions, against 30.4%, 41.0%, and 21.8% for hybrid search and 61.1%, 81.7%, and 70.4% for the fine-tuned retriever with the same labels. With off-the-shelf search, the cross-encoder without fine-tuning is 21 points lower. A zero-shot 8B reranker needs no labels and, routed by database, shows no resolved complete@15 difference on two collections; adding its scores as two fusion features gives a high-accuracy mode that reaches 72.4%, 92.5%, and 88.6%, ahead of the validation-selected zero-shot reranker variant on two collections, with no resolved difference on the third. Rank fusion of the two trained parts, grouped by database, shows no resolved difference from the learned fusion. Scored once on a newer BEAVER release, NIFT-SQL beats search and leads the label-matched retriever at top 8 on the synthetic test, but trails it at top 15 on real questions.
papers.assessment_note: 三个企业表检索集合、多次训练与同标签对照；迁移UGC需适配
papers.summary: 企业文本转 SQL 的第一步是找表，可 schema 里常常只有晦涩的表名和列名，一条查询要用的表少找到一张都不够，通用检索在这里很吃力。NIFT-SQL 用每家客户自己的示例问题单独训练，让一个小 cross-encoder 逐表判断这张表是否必需，再和同样微调过的混合检索融合。在近千张表的 LiveSQLBench-Large 上，把需要的表全部排进前十五位的问题比例，未微调的混合检索是 21.8%，NIFT-SQL 是 85.6%，只微调检索器也有 70.4%。这个领先并不稳，换到更新的 BEAVER 版本、只用合成问题训练时，它在真实问题上输给了只微调的检索器。==手里有标注问题时，微调检索器本身就是便宜又强的基线==，打分模型的价值在能放进上下文的表很少时最明显。

papers.title: Two-Sided Conformal Evidence Sets for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can surface passages that support a claim, contradict it, or fail to address it, yet existing calibrated grounding methods are typically one-sided and model only supporting evidence. We introduce Conformal Evidence Sets (CES), a two-sided framework that returns separate support and refutation sets with finite-sample inclusion coverage of at least $1-\alpha$ on each side under exchangeability; a Bonferroni union yields joint coverage of at least $1-2\alpha$. On labeled candidate pools from the contrastive VitaminC benchmark, CES closely tracks nominal coverage across $\alpha\!\in\!\{0.05,0.10,0.15,0.20,0.30\}$, with maximum deviations of $3.0$ percentage points for support and $5.4$ for refutation, and reaches essentially the same empirical coverage--size frontier as a test-tuned fixed-threshold heuristic without any test exposure. Stress tests mark the boundary of that guarantee: under FEVER distribution shift both sides under-cover, by up to $12.7$ percentage points, and support-side group-stratified recalibration substantially reduces the support gap. Scorer swaps, hard-negative retrieval, cross-dataset transfer, and a live end-to-end pilot expose a clear separation: when exchangeability holds and relevant evidence is retrieved, evidence inclusion remains calibrated even with an imperfect scorer, whereas the support/refute verdict tracks scorer quality directly. Calibrated evidence coverage and reliable verdicts are therefore distinct properties and should be reported separately.
papers.assessment_note: 有限样本覆盖保证；分布漂移下失效边界明确
papers.summary: RAG 检索回来的段落可能支持一个说法，也可能反驳它，现有的校准方法大多只管支持这一边，反驳的证据没人兜底。这篇用共形预测（靠一批带标注的样本定阈值，给出覆盖率保证）给支持和反驳各出一个证据集，保证每边按设定的概率至少含一条真证据，前提是相关证据已经被检索回来。换打分模型时差别最清楚，换成弱模型后证据覆盖率仍贴着目标，判断准确率却从 0.898 掉到 0.516。数据分布一变，覆盖率也守不住，FEVER 上最多少了 12.7 个百分点，要用部署环境的带标注数据重新校准。==证据找得全和结论下得对是两件事==，做 RAG 评测时要分开报告，打分模型弱的问题靠校准补不回来。

papers.title: Calibrating Document-Local Boundaries for Contextual Chunk Retrieval
papers.authors: Yuanxiang Wang, Hui Jiang, Da Zhu, Zhihua Chang
papers.abstract: Late Chunking encodes an entire document before pooling at chunk boundaries, preserving document context in local retrieval units. Chunk-level post-training improves context-dependent retrieval, but shared context can make semantically similar same-document negatives difficult to distinguish. We study the local decision boundary between a gold chunk and its hardest sibling. Starting from InSeNT, we analyze InSeNT's within-document gradients and show that the entropy of the conditional negative allocation decreases monotonically with the scaling factor at fixed logits. We propose a two-part framework for calibrating document-local chunk boundaries. The first component adapts the discriminative scale from within-document margins, while the second exposes chunk partitions to attention during document encoding. Experiments on ConTEB and NanoBEIR show that the resulting model improves contextual chunk retrieval across the evaluated encoder settings while retaining competitive passage-level retrieval quality; ablations further characterize the distinct roles of adaptive scaling and chunk-aware routing.
papers.assessment_note: ConTEB、NanoBEIR及消融；文档内困难负例与分块路由
papers.summary: Late Chunking 先编码整篇文档再切块，上下文保住了，同一文档里相似的文本块却更难区分，比如同一个球员不同赛季的进球记录。在用同文档负例微调的基线 InSeNT 上，排错的问题里有 82.21% 是同文档的另一块得分压过了正确块。阿里 Qwen 团队的 DcLBC 改了两处。一是看正确块和同文档得分最高的错误块差多少，差得越小，这条 query 的分数放大得越多，二是把文本块边界告诉编码阶段的注意力层，两处都不动 embedding 维度和检索流程。按同文档竞争强度分四档看，NDCG@10 的提升集中在最难的一档，加了 5.46 个点，容易的两档几乎不动。==长文档检索的错误，很多出在同一文档内部的区分上==，做段落检索时值得把这类错误单独统计。
